problems.title: False preconditioning loss rearrangement and reciprocal weight
problems.claim: Eqs14-24 derive a unit-scale normalized training loss and its time weight.
problems.claim_location: AppendixA.3 pp16-17; Eq15→16 and20,24; main Section4.3
assumptions: Independent centered endpoint coordinate variances a1,b16
The numeric Eq15/16 realization values are integrands, not full expected losses; Gaussian expectation witness uses F identically zero.
problems.check: Exact factorization, pointwise rational witness and conditional endpoint expectations; inequality persists under time averaging.
problems.result: At the stated realization, Eq15/16 integrands are65536/4913 and1024/289. At fixedt=.5 their Gaussian endpoint expectations are4096/289 and64/17. Correct normalized coefficient is lambda*c_out²; unit coefficient requires lambda=1/c_out².
problems.counterevidence: Positive time weights share unrestricted population minimizer; c_in,c_skip and final c_out remain useful; release uses lambda1
problems.impact: Invalid derivation directly defines and justifies core training preconditioning; generic flow consistency not refuted

correction.statement: Correct normalized regression factorization and reciprocal weight; intended/historical training unresolved
